basic_profile.bio: I'm a newcomer to Reddit, having joined about six months ago. My primary interest is in martial arts, particularly judo, which I've been practicing for the past year. I live in Boulder, Colorado, where I work part-time at a local bookstore while attending college. I'm studying kinesiology, which ties into my passion for physical activities and sports. I enjoy sharing my progress and learning from more experienced practitioners. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings after training sessions or work. I'm currently single and enjoy the freedom to focus on my studies and hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge in judo stems from my classes and a lot of self-study, including reading books and watching instructional videos. I'm also expanding my understanding of human movement and physical performance through my kinesiology studies.
